senses.gloss: (v. preced.; cmp. Syr. בלמא halter) to attempt to get rid of the halter; to kick, strike (of an unruly horse). Pesik. Zakh. p. 24ᵇ (ref. to Ps. XXXII, 9) thou puttest a bit on him והוא בוֹלֵם and he strikes.
units: <cite ref="Psalms 32:9">Ib.</cite> <he>קריב לגביה והוא ב׳</he> (strike out <cite ref="L00003"><he>לא</he></cite>, as Tanḥ. ed. Bub. Ki Thetse, 6 a.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 719">Yalk. Ps. 719</cite>) you come near him and he strikes; Tanḥ. Ki Thetse, 6; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 938:32">Yalk. Deut. 938</cite>, Ps. l. c. (with var. vers.).
